scene: The family goes shopping at the supermarket.
prompt: Do they bring reusable bags from home, or ask for new bags at the store?
feedbackBest: Great choice! A reusable bag can be used hundreds of times instead of being thrown away right away.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Reusable bags cut down even more waste — want to try again?

scene: There's good food left over from last night's dinner.
prompt: Do they save the leftovers for tomorrow, or throw them away right away?
feedbackBest: Great choice! Storing leftovers in a container turns them into a new meal, with nothing wasted.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Saving leftovers avoids food waste — want to try again?

scene: An apple in the fruit basket has a small bruise, but it's fine on the inside.
prompt: Do they cut off the bruised part and eat the rest, or throw the whole apple away?

options.label: Cut off and eat the rest

feedbackBest: Great choice! A small bruise doesn't ruin the whole fruit — this way no good food goes to waste.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Using the good part of the fruit cuts down on waste — want to try again?

scene: It's time to brush teeth before bed.
prompt: Do they leave the tap running the whole time, or turn it off while brushing?
feedbackBest: Great choice! Turning off the tap while brushing saves many liters of water.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Turning off the tap while brushing saves even more water — want to try again?

scene: No one has been in the living room for an hour, but the light is still on.
prompt: Do they turn off the light in the empty room, or leave it on?
feedbackBest: Great choice! Turning off the light in an empty room saves energy at no cost to anyone.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Turning off the light when no one's in the room saves energy — want to try again?

scene: The phone charger finished charging a long time ago.
prompt: Do they unplug the charger, or leave it plugged in without needing it?
feedbackBest: Great choice! Unplugging chargers that aren't being used avoids wasting energy for nothing.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Unplugging the charger when it's not needed saves energy — want to try again?

scene: A piece of paper is needed for a quick drawing.
prompt: Do they use the back of an already-used sheet, or grab a fresh new one?

options.label: Use the back of a used sheet

feedbackBest: Great choice! Reusing the back of a used sheet saves paper and trees.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Reusing scrap paper cuts down even more waste — want to try again?

scene: After the snack, banana and fruit peels are left on the table.
prompt: Do they put the peels in the regular trash, or in the compost/organics bin?
feedbackBest: Great choice! Fruit peels turn into fertilizer in the compost instead of taking up space in the trash.
feedbackGentle: Good try! Sorting peels into compost cuts down even more waste — want to try again?
